scope: One saved stream; no model/checkpoint/action imports, replay or new predictions.
Target key/document/span indexing is external posthoc analysis of authored bytes.
Empty values have no payload-byte start; their value boundary is punctuation.
STOP has no canonical reader teacher; memory payload is descriptive only.
EOS contribution is m_EOS*exp(log_posterior_s); three categories are disjoint.
This reconstructs the observed first EOS likelihood, never a counterfactual output.
Other codec outputs, later wrong-byte causes and training dynamics remain unresolved.
